items.text: – Ni mawe ya marumalu. Marumalu inamaanisha ghali sana.
items.q: A boy is meant to mispronounce 'marble' and think it means expensive. Is 'marumalu' a natural child's slip of 'marumaru', still recognizable?
before: Tuliendelea tena. Katikati ya njia kulikuwa na nyumba. Ukuta wake ulikuwa mzuri. Ghassem alikuwa akisema daima:
